scenes.title: Actual browser monitoring of the official V3 node
scenes.caption: Eleven samples produced 99 successful reads at 09:50-09:54 UTC. Best and finalized blocks advanced. Stopping preserved an offline report that later became stale.
scenes.source: Actual public Site6 browser screenshot; original capture 4 Nov 2026. Monitor JSON preserves exact sample times.

scenes.title: A reachable endpoint with the wrong expected identity
scenes.caption: For this negative test, only expected genesis was deliberately changed. Nine real samples remained identity-abnormal although RPC was reachable. The correct identity was restored.
scenes.source: Actual browser negative test; crop focuses on configured/observed genesis and independent status rows.

scenes.title: Real record(1), imported into execution review
scenes.caption: The actual update entered native block 318407. The collector matched its event, contract, caller and sequence. Finalized head 318410 linked through three exact parent edges.
scenes.source: Actual imported RPC report UI, 4 Nov 2026. This is offline review of the saved real record.

scenes.title: Actual JSON roundtrip and four A4 report pages
scenes.caption: The browser downloaded this real report and reimported that file with unchanged facts and digest. Actual A4 printing kept source, original times, stages and offline limitations.
scenes.source: Four actual Chrome PDF pages, arranged side by side without altering report content. Full PDF is included in materials.

scenes.title: The same real report replays through the CLI
scenes.caption: All six supplied stages agree and replay exits zero. Imported RPC evidence stays offline with all three trust/write flags false. SHA-256 checks content integrity, not consensus.
